entries.name: Cross-game parlay
entries.definition: Two or more legs from different games, priced at the operator's combined quote.
entries.would_accept: A directly validated joint probability across the legs and the operator rule both registered.
entries.would_reject: Any loss that the operator rule would have voided, which would prove the rule was not captured.
entries.closed_because: An operator's void, push and settlement rule for a combined ticket, plus a permitted price.
entries.stake_reason: A combination may not be staked while its division is closed.
entries.gate: JG-1 (joint evidence) and V7 (price)

entries.name: Same-game parlay
entries.definition: Two or more legs in one game, priced at the operator's same-game quote.
entries.would_accept: A joint probability measured at the exact thresholds on a prospective sample, plus the operator rule.
entries.would_reject: A measured joint rate indistinguishable from the marginal product, which would make the simple product acceptable after all.
entries.closed_because: The measured phi of -0.096 between side and total is not zero, so a marginal product is wrong; and no operator rule is registered.
entries.stake_reason: A combination may not be staked while its division is closed.
entries.gate: JG-1 (joint evidence) and V7 (price)

entries.name: Player prop combination
entries.definition: Two or more player props, in one game or across games.
entries.would_accept: Per-player game logs for every player in the combination, from a registered official source.
entries.would_reject: A captured prop outcome that contradicts the official game log, which would show the source is unreliable.
entries.closed_because: No player-level prop line or outcome is captured; the prop division is closed (PG-PROPS).
entries.stake_reason: A combination may not be staked while its division is closed.
entries.gate: JG-1 (joint evidence) and V7 (price)
